title: Manual results EVIDENCE-COLLECTION input -- an upstream, pre-archival artifact consumed only by convert-manual-results-evidence, never directly by ingest-manual-results
description: The shape an LLM-driven evidence-collection pass (this schema's own schema_version constant names it 'predictbot.manual-results-evidence.v1') actually produces: one result per supplied fixture, joined by fixture_id back to an already-recorded forecast, with zero or more corroborating sources whose evidence_sha256 is null until the separate evidence-preservation tool (manual_evidence_archiver.py / archive-manual-results-evidence) retrieves and archives each cited page. convert-manual-results-evidence never fabricates that hash -- see this module's own docstring.

evidence_sha256.description: Null until the separate evidence-preservation tool (manual_evidence_archiver.py / archive-manual-results-evidence) retrieves and archives the cited page. convert-manual-results-evidence treats null here as SETTLE_EVIDENCE_NOT_ARCHIVED -- it never computes or fabricates this hash itself.
